name: Compressive Gradient Rendering
definition: A compressive rendering method that renders discrete gradient components instead of pixel values to exploit sparsity in the Fourier domain, then reconstructs the image using a Poisson solver.
summary: Compressive Gradient Rendering recovers high-quality images from sparse samples by exploiting gradient sparsity in the Fourier domain, distinguishing itself from other methods by using the Fourier basis to avoid coherence issues with random sampling.
